_provenance.note: Measured BEFORE PC.1 fixed the applicability sample (2/14 -> 13/14 documents detecting a schema) and before N.5a carried the pass counters through the merge. So the entity counts here come from runs that mostly took the legacy single-schema path, and over_generation_rate / abstain_rate are null because the merge discarded the counters that would have produced them - not because nothing was culled. The gate reports those two dimensions as SKIPPED rather than passing them.
